from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re,copy
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def readj(name):return json.loads((OUT/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
def save_new(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'原输出保持：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
raw=readj('全部29企业家原全文与当前周转字段_自动原输出.json');rows=copy.deepcopy(raw['targets']);pagesby={z['quarter']:z for z in raw['all_original_pages_full_text']}
mrow=next(z for z in rows if z['quarter']=='2020Q4');assert mrow['pdf']['sha256']=='8c8a175b6a37f8bf5ce7b8de92b815639d0f5699bebed63a542c8f1d497ed193'
manual={'registered_at':now(),'quarter':'2020Q4','original_pdf':mrow['pdf'],'read_original_pages':[1,2,4,5,6],'current_original_title':'2020年第四季度企业家问卷调查报告','printed_date':'2021-01-19','current_field':'资金周转指数','current_value_percent':59.3,'current_good_percent':32.8,'current_general_percent':53.0,'current_difficult_percent':14.2,'original_table_current_row':'2020.Q4','original_method':'反映企业家对本企业本季资金周转情况判断的扩散指数。全部调查企业中，本季资金周转良好占比×1+一般占比×0.5。','original_population':'全国范围内除西藏外的5000多户工业企业。','originals_edited':False,'later_report_quotations_used':False,'initial_automatic_output_preserved':True,'new_fits':0}
save_new('同一2020Q4原页目视数值及方法.json',manual)
repairs=[]
for r in rows:
 body='\n'.join(z['full_text'] for z in pagesby[r['quarter']]['all_original_pages_full_text']);norm=re.sub(r'\s+','',body).replace('％','%')
 start=norm.rfind('编制说明');comp=norm[start:] if start>=0 else ''
 matches=re.findall(r'(?<!\d)\d+、资金周转指数[：:](.*?)(?=\d+、销货款回笼指数[：:])',comp,re.S)
 method=matches[0] if len(matches)==1 else ''
 method_ok=all(x in method for x in ['本企业','本季','良好','一般','权重','0.5'])
 if method!=r['current_original_method']:
  repairs.append({'quarter':r['quarter'],'old_method_flag':r['current_original_method_qualified'],'new_method_flag':method_ok,'old_method_text':r['current_original_method'],'new_same_original_method_text':method})
 r['current_original_method']=method;r['current_original_method_qualified']=method_ok
 r['method_read_contract']='只在同一原编制说明内定位编号+资金周转指数+下一销货款标题，防止小数7.0/7.8误当条款7。'
 if r['quarter']=='2020Q4':
  r.update({'current_value_percent':59.3,'current_requested_title_in_original_front':True,'current_original_method':manual['original_method'],'current_original_method_qualified':True,'original_industrial_population_qualified':True,'same_original_visual_completion':True,'read_original_pages':[1,2,4,5,6]})
 r['current_numeric_method_population_qualified']=bool(r['current_requested_title_in_original_front'] and r['current_value_percent'] is not None and r['current_original_method_qualified'] and r['original_industrial_population_qualified'])
 r['source_gate_qualified']=bool(r['current_numeric_method_population_qualified'] and r['original_publication_display'] and r['original_pdf_metadata_dates'] and not r['known_later_file_than_displayed_original_release'])
save_new('同一原编制说明定位修正谱系.json',{'registered_at':now(),'reason':'初正则未限制编制说明且允许小数点，误将数值7.0/7.8部分当条款；原全文/原数值保持，只同原方法定位修正，不改版本/公开钟。','original_automatic_output':ident(OUT/'全部29企业家原全文与当前周转字段_自动原输出.json'),'repairs':repairs,'manual_only_original':ident(OUT/'同一2020Q4原页目视数值及方法.json'),'new_fits':0,'new_labels':0,'new_network':0,'source_code_edits':0})
save_new('全部29当前资金周转值与方法_同一原件修正.json',{'study_id':readj('protocol.json')['study_id'],'completed_at':now(),'targets':rows,'same_original_repairs_only':True,'initial_outputs_preserved':True,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})
features8=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1/protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))['fixed_model_plan']['features8_reused']
meta=['idx','date','decision_time','orders_available_at','funding_available_at','valid_features','exit_idx']
parent=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1/原八字段与贷款总体需求_未读股票标签_v1_0_1.parquet'
d=pd.read_parquet(parent,columns=meta+features8);assert np.array_equal(d.index.to_numpy(),d.idx.to_numpy())
d['企业资金周转指数']=np.nan;d['周转经济季度']=None;d['周转原公布可知时间']=None;d['周转信息龄_自然日']=np.nan;d['周转源完整']=False
public=[(pd.Timestamp(r['original_publication_display']),r['quarter'],r) for r in rows]
for i,t in zip(d.idx.astype(int),pd.to_datetime(d.decision_time)):
 cutoff=pd.Timestamp(t)
 if cutoff.tzinfo is None:cutoff=cutoff.tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')
 eligible=[(ts,q,r) for ts,q,r in public if ts<=cutoff]
 if not eligible:continue
 q=max(x[1] for x in eligible);ts,q,r=max((x for x in eligible if x[1]==q),key=lambda x:x[0])
 d.loc[i,'周转经济季度']=q;d.loc[i,'周转原公布可知时间']=ts.isoformat();d.loc[i,'周转信息龄_自然日']=(cutoff-ts).total_seconds()/86400
 if r['source_gate_qualified']:d.loc[i,'企业资金周转指数']=r['current_value_percent'];d.loc[i,'周转源完整']=True
pools=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
members=sorted({int(z['idx']) for z in pools}|{int(i) for z in pools for i in z['training_indices']});assert len(members)==1711 and len(pools)==1212
d.to_parquet(OUT/'原八字段与企业周转_未读股票标签.parquet',index=False)
mf=d[d.idx.isin(members)][['idx','date','decision_time','企业资金周转指数','周转经济季度','周转原公布可知时间','周转信息龄_自然日','周转源完整']]
mf.to_csv(OUT/'全部1711原成员_周转当时公开支持.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
poolrows=[]
for z in pools:
 i=int(z['idx']);ids=[i]+[int(k) for k in z['training_indices']];known=d.loc[ids,'企业资金周转指数'].notna()
 poolrows.append({'idx':i,'date':z['date'],'original_mature_count':len(ids)-1,'current_known':bool(d.loc[i,'周转源完整']),'complete_current_and_original_pool_known':bool(known.all()),'unknown_current_and_mature_members':int((~known).sum()),'max_label_exit_idx':z['max_label_exit_idx'],'deleted_members':0})
pf=pd.DataFrame(poolrows);pf.to_csv(OUT/'全部1212原评分日_周转全成熟池支持.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
later=[{'quarter':z['quarter'],'pdf':z['pdf'],'original_display':z['original_publication_display'],'later_metadata':z['known_later_metadata'],'current_field':z['current_value_percent']} for z in rows if z['known_later_file_than_displayed_original_release']]
assert len(later)==1 and later[0]['quarter']=='2021Q1'
ready=all(z['source_gate_qualified'] for z in rows) and mf['企业资金周转指数'].notna().all() and pf.complete_current_and_original_pool_known.all()
assert not ready
gate={'study_id':readj('protocol.json')['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E84','completed_at':now(),'status':'SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED_2021Q1_CURRENT_PDF_LATER_THAN_DISPLAY_RELEASE','source_gate_passed':False,
 'current_original_quarters':29,'current_numeric_method_population_qualified':sum(z['current_numeric_method_population_qualified'] for z in rows),'current_numeric_bound_to_display_clock_without_known_later_file':sum(z['source_gate_qualified'] for z in rows),
 'known_later_current_carriers':later,'original_members':1711,'known_original_members':int(mf['企业资金周转指数'].notna().sum()),'original_score_dates':1212,'complete_current_and_original_mature_pools':int(pf.complete_current_and_original_pool_known.sum()),'deleted_members':0,
 'economic_test_status':'NOT_RUN_SOURCE_STAGE_ONLY','model_registration':'NOT_REGISTERED_FULL_SOURCE_GATE_FAILED','new_public_queries':4,'additional_web_opens':2,'new_original_target_GETs':58,'existing_catalogs_reused':5,'new_original_catalog_GETs':0,'target_retries':0,
 'new_equity_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'old_bank_rejections_preserved':True,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'actual_method':'本季资金周转良好占比×1+一般占比×0.5，5000多户工业企业主观扩散指数，非现金流金额或外生融资冲击。',
 'actual_remaining_issue':'2021Q1当前PDF附件名与元CreationDate/ModDate指向2021-03-26，发布页/原印刷日2021-03-25；未认证当时原字段载体，不改原钟、删该季或拖旧值。',
 'outputs':[ident(OUT/n) for n in ['全部29当前资金周转值与方法_同一原件修正.json','原八字段与企业周转_未读股票标签.parquet','全部1711原成员_周转当时公开支持.csv','全部1212原评分日_周转全成熟池支持.csv']]}
save_new('source_gate.json',gate);save_new('result.json',gate)
report=['# E84：企业资金周转原问题及完整来源','',
'在有限20个原研究/因子/决策及直链结果中未发现同企业家周转原字段金融用途。公司财报现金质量/回款旧研究和银行需求/审批的失败保持；有限核对不证明全repo穷尽。','',
'已取得全部29当前季度原企业家报告和各自发布页，5真实原目录复用、新目标GET58/重取0。原方法是良好比例加一般比例的一半，母体5000多户工业企业，非实际现金流或纯融资原因。国家统计局2025制度也确认是重点企业调查，由企业负责人/财务部门填报，不等于CSI300权重总体。','',
'原自动正则误将小数7.0/7.8当条款、2020Q4文字重字输出保存。仅同原编制说明定位修正；2020Q4原第1/2/4/5/6页完整目视确认59.3、32.8/53.0/14.2及原方法/工业母体，原件未改。','',
'全部29当前数值/方法/母体核实，但2021Q1当前PDF生成/文件名2021-03-26晚于原显示2021-03-25，28数值可保守绑原钟、1仍未认证。原1711与1212全部保持，未知不删除、填0或拖旧值；完整来源门失败，金融模型未登记/未运行，不能称资金周转机制无效。','',
json.dumps(gate,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),'',
'下一可用行动只查是否有真正不同的原2021Q1早版或独立当时官方全文，须另登记有限原版本证据路线；不重下载当前相同PDF、不改公开钟/时期/池。当前字段没有股票收益结果，不指定金融变体。',
'','[协议](protocol.json)、[原29全文初输出](全部29企业家原全文与当前周转字段_自动原输出.json)、[同原修正](全部29当前资金周转值与方法_同一原件修正.json)、[完整源裁决](source_gate.json)。']
rp=OUT/'企业资金周转_原问题及完整来源结论.md';assert not rp.exists();rp.write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'状态':gate['status'],'全部数值及原方法':gate['current_numeric_method_population_qualified'],'可接原显示钟':gate['current_numeric_bound_to_display_clock_without_known_later_file'],'原1711已知':gate['known_original_members'],'全1212成熟池已知':gate['complete_current_and_original_mature_pools'],'唯一版本问题':'2021Q1','金融及源码':0},ensure_ascii=False))
